controls.what: the sidebar test is no longer run against the development server
the development server starts without in-memory accounts
a mutation whose anchor is gone from app.js counts as caught

mutations.old:
elif grep -q -e 'mutation anchor missing' -e 'unknown mutation' mutation.log; then
              echo "::error title=sidebar mutation::$m has no anchor in the code"; cat mutation.log; missed=1

controls.what: an uncaught mutation no longer fails the job
the guards test is dropped from the browser job
the sidebar test reads the project status from the server's 503 again (T3 reverted)
one guard is no longer taken out (R4, the second click)
a sidebar mutation that crashes or finds no server counts as caught again

mutations.old:
elif ! grep -q AssertionError mutation.log; then
              # a crash, a dead server or a timeout also exits non-zero; only a failed assertion is a catch
              echo "::error title=sidebar mutation::$m failed without an assertion, so it was not caught"; cat mutation.log; missed=1
mutations.new: # NEGATIVE CONTROL: any non-zero exit is a catch

controls.what: the sidebar step may fail and the job still passes (continue-on-error)

mutations.old:
- name: Sidebar against the development API, and its mutations
        timeout-minutes: 9
mutations.new:
- name: Sidebar against the development API, and its mutations
        timeout-minutes: 9
        continue-on-error: true  # NEGATIVE CONTROL

controls.what: the guards test's failure is swallowed by || true

mutations.new: - run: node tests/workspace_guards_browser.cjs || true  # NEGATIVE CONTROL

controls.what: the sidebar script runs under set +e, so a failed run no longer stops it

mutations.new:
timeout-minutes: 9
        run: |
          set +e  # NEGATIVE CONTROL
          OMNI_ENV=development
